messages:
elaine: Heads-up: midsize customer on our trial hit repeated 502s during a sales demo, they paused. using hosted sandbox with ~15 concurrent streams.
rafael: which team/tenant? any request ids?
elaine: tenant=globex-poc. req ids: g_7b1a2, g_7b1a9. UI shows "service unavailable (502)" and a toast saying "retrying".
tom: checking metrics now. region-eu-central swarm queue_len spiked to ~180, gpu_mem 89%, io wait high. no runtime deploys in last 15m.
infra-bot: autoscaler: at 1791123940 -> scale_up queued (pending image pull), available_idle_gpus=0, fallback routed 42 requests to small-pool.
rafael: small-pool has lower concurrency. if primary saturates and fallback becomes hotspot we'll get cascading 5xx.
elainE: (typo) sorry, meant elaine.
priya: quick mitigation: can we toggle per-tenant "force_model_variant=shortctx" or reduce max_tokens? also consider turning on aggressive kv_eviction.
tom: I see heavy KV cache churn in logs: "kv_cache_eviction: thrash_detected" and frequent GC cycles. long streaming transcripts (~10k tokens) + concurrency is the likely cause.
rafael: propose immediate steps: 1) switch tenant to a shorter-context model, 2) set max_tokens=4096, 3) enable prefix_cache for repeated system prompt, 4) carve short burst reservation for demo window.
elaine: customer asks if we can guarantee the demo for their exec call in 30m. they balk at adding dedicated capacity cost.
sales-bot: quick quote: 2x T4-equivalent reserved mini-pool (monthly) ~ $5.5k/mo, one-off burst window (2h) credit charge ~$120.
priya: I'll push model swap and lower tokens now. can someone prep a quick script for ops to carve a 2h burst?
infra-bot: action: apply config for tenant globex-poc -> model=rwf-compact, max_tokens=4096 at 1791124022. rollout 100% to sandbox.
elaine: customer switched and resumed demo, errors much reduced but still occasional 502 on longer transcripts.
tom: fallback small-pool still under pressure. need to prevent fallback flood. adding a hard cap on fallback queue to 50 would reject early instead of thrashing.
rafael: opened INF-4999 to track: "fallback queue hard cap + warm standby for trials" assigned to eng-runtime.
priya: also flagged security ask: globex wants VPC peering + bring-your-own-kms for PII. they want SOC2 docs and an NDA before we share.
elaine: I'll send NDA and the security checklist. please bundle SOC2 summary doc.
sales-bot: note: enterprise sales can include temporary dedicated demo environments as part of trial playbook; ops spins up and we bill as credits. approval path needed but feasible.
rafael: long-term engineering action items: - reduce autoscale latency (image prewarm/warm standby), - improve kv_cache eviction heuristics, - per-tenant circuit breaker to avoid fallback cascade.
tom: adding a short runbook snippet to INF-4998 (quick POC recovery): 
```
# POC recovery quick steps
1. swap to short-context model
2. set max_tokens=4096
3. enable prefix_cache
4. carve 1-2h burst reservation
5. monitor queue_len < 60 and gpu_mem < 85%
```
priya: customer wants a postmortem and confirmation of permanent fixes before next exec. elaine, can you own comms?
elaine: yes, I'll own it and share ETA for next steps. attaching logs to ticket INF-4997: s3://redwood-logs/poc/globex/17911239/.
infra-bot: alert: error_rate baseline restored at 1791124165.
elaine: thanks all, will follow up with sales and security. :white_check_mark:
